faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: Do my customers need an account?
faq.a1: No. Customers continue using email, WhatsApp or your web form as usual. They never interact with the platform.
faq.q2: Can I connect multiple email addresses?
faq.a2: Yes. You can connect multiple email inboxes and WhatsApp numbers to the same workspace.
faq.a3: New tickets are created from the moment you connect your channels. You can also create tickets manually.
faq.a4: Yes. The free plan has no time limit and includes the core features you need.
